programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Mega Engineering

programme.title: Street Outlaws: Memphis
programme.desc: 'S1/E29 - Mid Atlantic Meltdown'. The MSO family takes on the Mid Atlantic Street Outlaws, whose awesome cars include a doorless dragster. Can Memphis keep up with the pace?

programme.title: Street Outlaws: Memphis
programme.desc: 'S1/E30 - Small Tire Mountaineers'. The Memphis family is at an air strip in West Virginia for the small tyre event of JJ's Arm Drop, in a bid to take home the $15,000 prize.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: 'S10/E11 - Superbird'. Fuller and Bumpus show how to take a classic to the next level. They do a headliner and a factory vinyl top on a rare classic Plymouth Superbird.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: 'S15/E5'. Follow the amazing manufacturing processes behind Worcestershire sauce, lawn bowls and radio-controlled model jets.

programme.title: Dirty Jobs
programme.desc: 'S5/E4 - Pinsetter Mechanic'. Mike spends the day at a bowling centre to learn how they keep the lanes running smoothly. Then he responds to a letter from a fan who wants to see more footage of cameraman Doug.

programme.title: Dirty Jobs
programme.desc: 'S5/E5 - Woolen Mill Operator'. Mike spends a day working at Ohio Valley Natural Fibers, where he makes yarn from fleece. Then he goes to work at a day spa in Michigan, where he helps wax hair.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: 'S15/E6'. Follow the amazing manufacturing processes behind pipes, rock climbing gear, leather bike saddles and luxury sports cars.

programme.title: Street Outlaws: Memphis
programme.desc: 'S1/E31 - Arm Drop In Appalachia'. JJ and the Memphis family gear up for the big tyre event of JJ's Arm Drop in West Virginia. The asphalt on this former airstrip is sketchy - and dangerous.

programme.title: Street Outlaws: Memphis
programme.desc: 'S1/E32 - Appalachian Accidents'. The big tyre event of JJ's Arm Drop in West Virginia continues into round two. Can somebody from the Memphis family make it to the end and win the $25,000?

programme.title: Dirty Jobs
programme.desc: 'S5/E6 - Lightning Rod Installer'. Mike spends a day installing lightning rods on a home that looks like a castle. He is told to wear multiple pairs of underpants to protect him from being burnt while on the rooftop.

programme.title: Dirty Jobs
programme.desc: 'S5/E7 - Sea Lamprey Exterminator'. In Michigan, Mike helps the US Department of Fish and Wildlife control the sea lamprey population. At Mandalay Bay Casino he makes 'meat gel' to feed the fish in the aquarium.

programme.title: Cooper's Treasure
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Hunt For The Gold Table'. After discovering a 1700s-era cannon Darrell seeks the ship's origin. A letter in Gordon's files details a 16th century wreck connected to Sir Francis Drake.

programme.title: Cooper's Treasure
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Wreck In The Shallows'. Darrell heads to a shipwreck linked to Gordo's list. He leads his team to the shallows where the tough winds and waves have claimed centuries worth of ships.

programme.title: Supertruckers
programme.desc: 'S3/E8'. Metcalfe's stands to attention with two huge military moves - which include shifting 17 armoured vehicles from Salisbury Plain to the biggest British army base in the world.

programme.title: Garage Squad

programme.title: Trans Am

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: 'S6/E8 - Rebuild: '66 Nova Part 2'. Joe pulls out all the stops to make the '66 Nova the car of his client's dreams. In addition to the mean motor and big tyres, he wants a chopped roof.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: 'S6/E9 - Full Throttle Custom Rivi'. A customer from New York entrusts Martin Bros. with his prized 1965 Buick Riviera. And when it's done, it won't be his father's Buick anymore.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Rebellious Na Cha kills the Dragon King's son, sparking divine wrath. After a sacrifice, he is reborn more powerful than ever and rises to fight for justice.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Dr Lam diagnoses the latest phenomenon as more citizens become 'infected'. He decides to stop the vampires from turning more citizens.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: Two brothers, one a drug lord and the other a police officer, clash in an endless battle between good and evil in a drug cartel's turf war.

programme.title: Playboy Cops
programme.desc: Two eccentric young detectives search for a killer to bring him to justice while vying for the affections of a young woman.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: A police sniper teams up with a hot-headed rookie to take down his former friend and teammate who is exacting revenge on the police.

programme.title: Helios
programme.desc: When the notorious criminal, Helios steals a powerful weapon from South Korea and attempts to sell it in Hong Kong, the police forces of these two lands must join hands.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwangtung
programme.desc: Anti-Ch'ing revolutionary leader, Chai Min Yu, is being hunted down by Manchu General Liang. He is almost caught when a masked man rescues him from death and escapes with him.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Heir to a demon-hunting clan, Ma Xiao Ling teams up with Kuang Tian You, a vampire posing as an immortal detective, to stop shadow attacks and resolve a century-old feud.

programme.title: Century of the Dragon
programme.desc: An undercover detective is assigned to take down a triad boss. However, he instead develops a friendship with the crime lord and is soon torn between duty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: An underground boxer loses his memory while escaping from the Bangkok triad. When he regains his memory after starting anew, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: The Monkey King emerges after the Goddess Nuwa's sacrifice to challenge the Jade Emperor. This leads to chaos that enables Buffalo Demon to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Gun N' Rose
programme.desc: A Taiwanese gang boss names his adopted son Long Yi as his successor. This provokes Long Er (his biological son) to murder his father. Long Yi must now confront Long Er in a final battle.

programme.title: Bruce Lee, My Brother
programme.desc: A Bruce Lee biopic as told by his younger brother Robert. Following Bruce Lee's journey from a defiant youth in Hong Kong to his global triumph as an 18-year-old in the USA.

programme.title: The Heroic Trio
programme.desc: Newborn babies destined to be emperors are kidnapped by the Evil Master. The police are powerless, so the city must be saved by three women with superb fighting skills.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: A high class prostitute (Shih Szu) uses a famous swordsman (Ti Lung) and a thief (Fu Sheng) to take revenge on the 'Killer Doctor' who betrayed her brother many years ago.

programme.title: Martial Arts Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Jet Li weasels out of the Shaolin temple to assassinate a despotic ruler at the ruler's extravagant public birthday celebration.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: Lin Lang and his mercenary squad must protect a mysterious Chinese woman from assassins worldwide and a notorious fugitive, all drawn by a record-breaking bounty.

programme.title: The Avenging Fist
programme.desc: A young man uses the martial arts skill created by his father, and the Power Glove, a tool that unleashes mind power, to battle rebels who intend to dominate the world.

programme.title: Skinny Tiger & Fatty Dragon
programme.desc: Detective Baldy and his partner Fatty stumble upon the robbery of a jewelry store, which puts them on the trail of a triad crime syndicate.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When a sergeant loses his police revolver to four young triad thugs, he seeks help from a PTU sergeant and his patrolling team to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of The Martial World
programme.desc: A popular tale of a brother and sister seeking vengeance for the death of their parents through the mythical yin/yang holy flame technique is a visual epic.

programme.title: Huang Feihong The Black Yamen
programme.desc: In the late Qing Dynasty, Wong Fei Hung investigates the sinister Black Yamen, led by Chief Eunuch Cao. Upon uncovering their treachery, he sets out to bring them to justice.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan.

programme.title: Rosa
programme.desc: Two bumbling cops must retrieve a roll of film containing the criminal evidence against a drug cartel from the informant's girlfriend, Rosa, to track down the gangsters.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three men who are close as brothers is put through the ultimate test when one of them gives in to corruption and pursues his love for his friend's wife.

programme.title: Back on the Society
programme.desc: A retired triad leader is drawn back into the underworld after rescuing an ally. When his daughter is kidnapped, he launches a war against a ruthless crime syndicate.

programme.title: The New Option
programme.desc: An elite cop fulfils his dream to join the Special Duty Unit. Now, he faces rigorous training and the challenge of stopping a daring heist by a gang of dangerous criminals.

programme.title: Dragon Squad
programme.desc: A veteran cop leads a team of Interpol agents to track down ruthless mercenaries who kidnapped an accused crime lord on his way to court.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Former street fighter Neng seeks a fresh start in Kowloon Walled City, but is drawn into a brutal gang war. When his friend is targeted, he leads a desperate resistance.

programme.title: Wild Search
programme.desc: In a gun trafficking raid, a police officer finds the little girl who witnessed her mother's murder by the ruthless gunrunners, and must protect her from being killed.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: A team of skilled fighters navigate a house rigged with an array of ingenious and deadly traps.

programme.title: Trivisa
programme.desc: At the dawn of 1997, three notorious Hong Kong thieves coincidentally meet in a restaurant, sparking rumours of a huge combined heist.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Rebellious Na Cha kills the Dragon King's son, sparking divine wrath. After a sacrifice, he is reborn more powerful than ever and rises to fight for justice.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Dr Lam diagnoses the latest phenomenon as more citizens become 'infected'. He decides to stop the vampires from turning more citizens.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: Two brothers, one a drug lord and the other a police officer, clash in an endless battle between good and evil in a drug cartel's turf war.

programme.title: Playboy Cops
programme.desc: Two eccentric young detectives search for a killer to bring him to justice while vying for the affections of a young woman.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: A police sniper teams up with a hot-headed rookie to take down his former friend and teammate who is exacting revenge on the police.

programme.title: Helios
programme.desc: When the notorious criminal, Helios steals a powerful weapon from South Korea and attempts to sell it in Hong Kong, the police forces of these two lands must join hands.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwangtung
programme.desc: Anti-Ch'ing revolutionary leader, Chai Min Yu, is being hunted down by Manchu General Liang. He is almost caught when a masked man rescues him from death and escapes with him.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Heir to a demon-hunting clan, Ma Xiao Ling teams up with Kuang Tian You, a vampire posing as an immortal detective, to stop shadow attacks and resolve a century-old feud.

programme.title: Century of the Dragon
programme.desc: An undercover detective is assigned to take down a triad boss. However, he instead develops a friendship with the crime lord and is soon torn between duty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: An underground boxer loses his memory while escaping from the Bangkok triad. When he regains his memory after starting anew, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: The Monkey King emerges after the Goddess Nuwa's sacrifice to challenge the Jade Emperor. This leads to chaos that enables Buffalo Demon to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Gun N' Rose
programme.desc: A Taiwanese gang boss names his adopted son Long Yi as his successor. This provokes Long Er (his biological son) to murder his father. Long Yi must now confront Long Er in a final battle.

programme.title: Bruce Lee, My Brother
programme.desc: A Bruce Lee biopic as told by his younger brother Robert. Following Bruce Lee's journey from a defiant youth in Hong Kong to his global triumph as an 18-year-old in the USA.

programme.title: The Heroic Trio
programme.desc: Newborn babies destined to be emperors are kidnapped by the Evil Master. The police are powerless, so the city must be saved by three women with superb fighting skills.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: A high class prostitute (Shih Szu) uses a famous swordsman (Ti Lung) and a thief (Fu Sheng) to take revenge on the 'Killer Doctor' who betrayed her brother many years ago.

programme.title: Martial Arts Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Jet Li weasels out of the Shaolin temple to assassinate a despotic ruler at the ruler's extravagant public birthday celebration.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: Lin Lang and his mercenary squad must protect a mysterious Chinese woman from assassins worldwide and a notorious fugitive, all drawn by a record-breaking bounty.

programme.title: The Avenging Fist
programme.desc: A young man uses the martial arts skill created by his father, and the Power Glove, a tool that unleashes mind power, to battle rebels who intend to dominate the world.

programme.title: Skinny Tiger & Fatty Dragon
programme.desc: Detective Baldy and his partner Fatty stumble upon the robbery of a jewelry store, which puts them on the trail of a triad crime syndicate.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When a sergeant loses his police revolver to four young triad thugs, he seeks help from a PTU sergeant and his patrolling team to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of The Martial World
programme.desc: A popular tale of a brother and sister seeking vengeance for the death of their parents through the mythical yin/yang holy flame technique is a visual epic.

programme.title: Huang Feihong The Black Yamen
programme.desc: In the late Qing Dynasty, Wong Fei Hung investigates the sinister Black Yamen, led by Chief Eunuch Cao. Upon uncovering their treachery, he sets out to bring them to justice.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan.

programme.title: Rosa
programme.desc: Two bumbling cops must retrieve a roll of film containing the criminal evidence against a drug cartel from the informant's girlfriend, Rosa, to track down the gangsters.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three men who are close as brothers is put through the ultimate test when one of them gives in to corruption and pursues his love for his friend's wife.

programme.title: Back on the Society
programme.desc: A retired triad leader is drawn back into the underworld after rescuing an ally. When his daughter is kidnapped, he launches a war against a ruthless crime syndicate.

programme.title: The New Option
programme.desc: An elite cop fulfils his dream to join the Special Duty Unit. Now, he faces rigorous training and the challenge of stopping a daring heist by a gang of dangerous criminals.

programme.title: Dragon Squad
programme.desc: A veteran cop leads a team of Interpol agents to track down ruthless mercenaries who kidnapped an accused crime lord on his way to court.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Former street fighter Neng seeks a fresh start in Kowloon Walled City, but is drawn into a brutal gang war. When his friend is targeted, he leads a desperate resistance.

programme.title: Wild Search
programme.desc: In a gun trafficking raid, a police officer finds the little girl who witnessed her mother's murder by the ruthless gunrunners, and must protect her from being killed.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: A team of skilled fighters navigate a house rigged with an array of ingenious and deadly traps.

programme.title: Trivisa
programme.desc: At the dawn of 1997, three notorious Hong Kong thieves coincidentally meet in a restaurant, sparking rumours of a huge combined heist.
